-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #36 / Scene #2 - Function alsmeer_justice_event5
function alsmeer_justice_event5()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town002D.map")
	MoveCamera(865.00, 527.50, 52.34)
	RotCamera(0.30, 1.37, 36.00)

	CreateObject(0, 5, 881.00, 533.00, 192, 0, FALSE, 1, 37)
	CreateObject(1, 1016, 849.00, 535.00, 40, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(2, 1017, 850.00, 520.00, 64, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM036.ogg")
	OpenTalkScene(6, 7)
	PlayCamera("alsmr_04_1.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(1000)
	AniObject(0, 19, 0)
	WalkObject(1, 880.000000, 526.000000, 52.340000, 1, 4, 0)
	WalkObject(2, 880.000000, 526.000000, 52.340000, 1, 4, 0)
	wait(150)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(alsmeer_justice_event5)
